baseline: torch.frexp on an MPS tensor raises NotImplementedError without the overlay
notes: The Metal kernel matches the CPU kernel bit for bit on every exponent field of the three dtypes, signed zeros included.
float16/bfloat16 NaN outputs are NaNs on both devices; the CPU kernel canonicalises their payload through float32 while the Metal kernel preserves the input bits.

Gradients come from the generated FrexpBackward0 rule (grad / 2**exponent), which is exact except where Metal's flush-to-zero meets exp2(127) or exp2(-127): exponent 127 gives 0 instead of the subnormal 2**-127, and exponent <= -127 gives inf. That needs |x| >= 2**126 or a subnormal input smaller than 2**-126.

The kernel moves 12 bytes per element for float32 and 8 for the 16-bit dtypes (input read, mantissa write, int32 exponent write), so mps_gbps is measured against that traffic, not against the input size alone. memcpy_gbps is torch.Tensor.copy_ on a buffer of the same shape, timed interleaved with the kernel in the same run; it is the rate the kernel has to reach to be at the physical floor. pct_of_memcpy is the per-window ratio of the two, so a sleepy GPU cancels out; 100% means the kernel is running at the memcpy rate. At 16M elements pct_of_memcpy lands between 85% and 100% across runs: the operator is bandwidth-bound and the remaining headroom is small, not a factor of 1.5. At 1M both frexp and copy_ are dominated by launch latency rather than bandwidth, so their ratio says little.

The shader issues its accesses four elements at a time. A contiguous tensor whose storage starts at an address the vector access cannot name (for example torch.empty(8, device='mps')[1:5]) falls back to a one-element-per-thread kernel with the same output.

Timings are per call, amortised over batches of 5 back-to-back calls around a single synchronize. speedup and mps_gbps use the best of 40 batches; the median of the same 40 is reported next to it as mps_ms / mps_gbps_median. They run under a shared tier-1 lease, so a median can be inflated several-fold by a concurrent probe while the best sample is the least contended one.
